## claude-in-chrome
**IMPORTANT: If the Chrome browser tools are deferred (must be loaded via ToolSearch before use), load them with ToolSearch before calling them, and batch every tool you expect to need into ONE ToolSearch call (the select query accepts a comma-separated list). Do NOT load tools one at a time; each separate ToolSearch call wastes a full round-trip.**

Start a browser task whose tools are not yet loaded with a single call loading the core set:

ToolSearch with query "select:mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_context_mcp,mcp__claude-in-chrome__navigate,mcp__claude-in-chrome__computer,mcp__claude-in-chrome__read_page,mcp__claude-in-chrome__tabs_create_mcp"

Add task-specific tools to the same call when the task obviously needs them: read_console_messages / read_network_requests for debugging, form_input for forms, gif_creator for recordings, javascript_tool for page scripting. Only issue a second ToolSearch if the task later needs a tool you did not anticipate.

## claude.ai Supabase
Here are guidelines for using Supabase tools effectively:

- Before making schema changes, use `list_tables` to understand the existing structure
- When debugging issues, start with `get_logs` and `get_advisors` before making changes
- Use `get_project_url` and `get_publishable_api_key` when helping users configure client-side integrations

If you have access to a local development environment with a filesystem and shell:
- Install the Supabase agent skill for critical development and security guidance: `npx skills add supabase/agent-skills` (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/getting-started/ai-skills.md)
- Use the Supabase CLI (`supabase`) for local development workflows such as starting a local stack, managing migrations, and running edge functions locally (https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development.md)
- Prefer local development and testing before applying changes to a remote project

If you are running in a web-only or remote environment without filesystem or shell access:
- Rely on the MCP tools directly for all Supabase interactions
- Use `apply_migration` carefully, as changes go directly to the remote project

## plugin:context7:context7
Use this server to fetch current documentation whenever the user asks about a library, framework, SDK, API, CLI tool, or cloud service — even well-known ones like React, Next.js, Prisma, Express, Tailwind, Django, or Spring Boot. Use even when you think you know the answer — your training data may not reflect recent changes. Prefer this over web search for library docs.

1:Attribute VB_Name = "CaseMatcher"
2:Option Explicit

4:' ============================================================
5:' CaseMatcher.bas
6:'
7:' Ports the manual SOP's case-identification and Epic join logic:
8:'   DedupeEfcRows       -- collapse repeat Encounter No rows, keep last occurrence
9:'   IdentifySmsRequired -- Comment string match, ports the existing IF formula
10:'   JoinPhoneFromEpic   -- CSN/Encounter No dictionary join against Epic
11:' See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-16-sms-broadcast-design.md for the
12:' identification rules and the dedup rationale.
13:' ============================================================
14:
15:' One matched or candidate SMS case, built by BuildReviewList (BroadcastBuilder.bas)
16:' from the flagged eFC working sheet. Fields match the columns actually used
17:' from the SMS TEMPLATE workbook (confirmed 2026-07-21): Encounter No, MRN,
18:' Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number (all three raw candidates, not
19:' collapsed to one -- so PSA can see and override what the tool would pick;
20:' see FirstUsableNumber). FC ID / Admission Date / Admission Status and the
21:' FTF/SMS checker column onward are disregarded -- not part of the real
22:' working process. No separate Bed field either (see JoinPhoneFromEpic).
23:Public Type SmsCase
24:    EncounterNo As String
25:    MRN As String
26:    PatientName As String
27:    Phone1 As String
28:    Phone2 As String
29:    Phone3 As String
30:End Type
31:
32:' Collapses repeat Encounter No rows in wsEfc, keeping only the LAST occurrence
33:' (bottom-most row in file order) per Encounter No -- see the Dedup Rule in the
34:' design spec: a repeat most plausibly means a re-export after a correction,
35:' and later rows reflect the more recent state.
36:' dupSummary receives one description string per collapsed Encounter No
37:' ("<EncounterNo> (<N> occurrences collapsed)"); dupCount is the number of
38:' distinct Encounter Nos affected (not the number of rows removed).
39:' Load-filter-write-delete strategy: one read, one write, one delete.
40:Public Sub DedupeEfcRows(wsEfc As Worksheet, ByRef dupSummary() As String, ByRef dupCount As Long)
41:    On Error GoTo Cleanup
42:
43:    dupCount = 0
44:    ReDim dupSummary(1 To 0)
45:
46:    If wsEfc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
47:
48:    ' Clear AutoFilter if active so hidden rows don't interfere or freeze delete operations
49:    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
50:
51:    Dim encCol As Long
52:    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
53:    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
54:
55:    Dim lastRow As Long
56:    lastRow = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
57:    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
58:
59:    Dim lastCol As Long
60:    lastCol = wsEfc.Cells(1, wsEfc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
61:    If lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub
62:
63:    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
64:
65:    Dim allData As Variant
66:    allData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(1, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value
67:
68:    ' --- Pass 1: last row index and occurrence count per Encounter No ---
69:    Dim lastIdx As Object, occCount As Object
70:    Set lastIdx = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
71:    Set occCount = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
72:
73:    Dim i As Long, key As String
74:    For i = 2 To lastRow
75:        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
76:        If key <> "" Then
77:            lastIdx(key) = i
78:            If occCount.Exists(key) Then
79:                occCount(key) = occCount(key) + 1
80:            Else
81:                occCount(key) = 1
82:            End If
83:        End If
84:    Next i
85:
86:    ' --- Pass 2: count rows to keep (blank keys always kept -- can't dedupe safely) ---
87:    Dim keepCount As Long
88:    keepCount = 0
89:    For i = 2 To lastRow
90:        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
91:        If key = "" Then
92:            keepCount = keepCount + 1
93:        ElseIf lastIdx(key) = i Then
94:            keepCount = keepCount + 1
95:        End If
96:    Next i
97:
98:    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
99:        GoTo Cleanup   ' nothing to collapse
100:    End If
101:
102:    ' --- Pass 3: build the compacted array of kept rows ---
103:    Dim filtData() As Variant
104:    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)
105:    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
106:    outRow = 0
107:    For i = 2 To lastRow
108:        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
109:        If key = "" Or lastIdx(key) = i Then
110:            outRow = outRow + 1
111:            For j = 1 To lastCol
112:                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
113:            Next j
114:        End If
115:    Next i
116:
117:    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData
118:    Dim newLastRow As Long

' For every row flagged "SMS REQUIRED" by IdentifySmsRequired, looks up Phone
' from wsEpic by CSN = Encounter No (constraint #4 in the design spec) and
' writes it into three new "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" columns appended after
' "MCAF Reminder" -- matching the SMS TEMPLATE's own H/I/J columns (all three
' raw candidates, not collapsed to one; see ExtractMobileNumbers). No Bed
' lookup -- dropped 2026-07-21: the columns actually used from the SMS
' TEMPLATE (Encounter No, MRN, Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number) don't
' include Bed, so there was nothing for a Bed value to feed. Rows with no
' Epic match are left blank on all three -- BuildReviewList
' (BroadcastBuilder.bas) already routes any row with no usable candidate to
' "Needs Manual Lookup" rather than dropping it. Bulk dictionary join, same
' pattern as the MFC macro's Epic lookup (EpicLookup.bas) -- one bulk read of
' Epic, one pass over eFC.
Public Sub JoinPhoneFromEpic(wsEfc As Worksheet, wsEpic As Worksheet)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup

    If wsEfc Is Nothing Or wsEpic Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
    If wsEpic.AutoFilterMode Then wsEpic.AutoFilterMode = False

    Dim epicCSNCol As Long, epicPhoneCol As Long
    epicCSNCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic CSN Header", "CSN"))
    epicPhoneCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic Phone Header", "Phone"))
    If epicCSNCol = 0 Or epicPhoneCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: Epic file is missing required columns for the Phone join.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long, mcafCol As Long
    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
    mcafCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, "MCAF Reminder")
    If encCol = 0 Or mcafCol = 0 Then Exit Sub   ' IdentifySmsRequired hasn't run yet

    Dim lastRowEfc As Long
    lastRowEfc = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowEfc < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRowEpic As Long
    lastRowEpic = wsEpic.Cells(wsEpic.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowEpic < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' --- Bulk-load Epic into CSN-keyed dictionaries, one per candidate slot ---
    Dim epicLastCol As Long
    epicLastCol = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(epicCSNCol, epicPhoneCol)
    Dim epicData As Variant
    epicData = wsEpic.Range(wsEpic.Cells(1, 1), wsEpic.Cells(lastRowEpic, epicLastCol)).Value

    Dim dictPhone1 As Object, dictPhone2 As Object, dictPhone3 As Object
    Set dictPhone1 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictPhone2 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictPhone3 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, csn As String, p1 As String, p2 As String, p3 As String
    For i = 2 To lastRowEpic
        csn = SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicCSNCol))
        ExtractMobileNumbers SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicPhoneCol)), p1, p2, p3
        dictPhone1(csn) = p1
        dictPhone2(csn) = p2
        dictPhone3(csn) = p3
    Next i

    ' --- Append "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" right after "MCAF Reminder" ---
    Dim phone1OutCol As Long, phone2OutCol As Long, phone3OutCol As Long
    phone1OutCol = mcafCol + 1
    phone2OutCol = mcafCol + 2
    phone3OutCol = mcafCol + 3
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone1OutCol).Value = "1st Phone Number"
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone2OutCol).Value = "2nd Phone Number"
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone3OutCol).Value = "3rd Phone Number"

    Dim efcData As Variant
    efcData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, mcafCol)).Value

    Dim phone1Out() As Variant, phone2Out() As Variant, phone3Out() As Variant
    ReDim phone1Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
    ReDim phone2Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
    ReDim phone3Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim encNo As String, flag As String
    For i = 1 To UBound(efcData, 1)
        flag = Trim(CStr(efcData(i, mcafCol)))
        If flag = "SMS REQUIRED" Then
            encNo = Trim(CStr(efcData(i, encCol)))
            If dictPhone1.Exists(encNo) Then
                phone1Out(i, 1) = dictPhone1(encNo)
                phone2Out(i, 1) = dictPhone2(encNo)
                phone3Out(i, 1) = dictPhone3(encNo)
            Else
                phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
                phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
                phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
            End If
        Else
            phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
            phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
            phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone1OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone1OutCol)).Value = phone1Out
    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone2OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone2OutCol)).Value = phone2Out
    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone3OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone3OutCol)).Value = phone3Out

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

' Ports the SMS TEMPLATE workbook's "1st/2nd/3rd phone number" formulas
' (columns H/I/J): Epic's raw phone field looks like
'   "*9327 2613 (Mobile)" & vbCrLf & "6677 1216 (Home Phone)" & vbCrLf & "9664 9678 (Work Phone)"
' -- one or more labelled numbers, asterisks marking a preferred number, and
' line breaks between entries. Strips spaces and asterisks (matching the
' template's inline SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(G2," ",""),"*","") step), then scans
' left to right for up to three non-overlapping 8-digit runs starting with
' "8" or "9" (the SG mobile prefixes), writing them into num1/num2/num3 in
' the order found. Deliberately does NOT reject Epic's "88888888"/"99999999"
' placeholder values here -- those are still valid *candidates* to show a
' human reviewer (see ReviewForm), same as the template's own H/I/J don't
' filter them either. Use FirstUsableNumber to pick one for the broadcast file.
Public Sub ExtractMobileNumbers(rawPhone As String, ByRef num1 As String, ByRef num2 As String, ByRef num3 As String)
    num1 = ""
    num2 = ""
    num3 = ""

    Dim cleaned As String
    cleaned = Replace(rawPhone, " ", "")
    cleaned = Replace(cleaned, "*", "")

    Dim n As Long
    n = Len(cleaned)

    Dim found As Long
    found = 0

    Dim i As Long, ch As String, candidate As String
    i = 1
    Do While i <= n - 7 And found < 3
        ch = Mid(cleaned, i, 1)
        If ch = "8" Or ch = "9" Then
            candidate = Mid(cleaned, i, 8)
            If IsEightDigits(candidate) Then
                found = found + 1
                Select Case found
                    Case 1: num1 = candidate
                    Case 2: num2 = candidate
                    Case 3: num3 = candidate
                End Select
                i = i + 8   ' non-overlapping: skip past this candidate

Public Sub LoadPlaceholderList(ByRef outList() As String, ByRef outCount As Long)
    LoadPhraseList "Epic Placeholder Numbers", Array("88888888", "99999999"), outList, outCount

' Picks the single number that goes into the final broadcast file (SOP step

Public Function FirstUsableNumber(num1 As String, num2 As String, num3 As String, _
                                   placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As String
    If IsUsableNumber(num1, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
        FirstUsableNumber = num1
    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num2, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
        FirstUsableNumber = num2
    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num3, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
        FirstUsableNumber = num3
    Else
        FirstUsableNumber = ""
    End If
End Function

Private Function IsUsableNumber(num As String, placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As Boolean
    If num = "" Then
        IsUsableNumber = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To placeholderCount
        If num = placeholders(i) Then
            IsUsableNumber = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    IsUsableNumber = True
End Function

Private Function IsEightDigits(s As String) As Boolean
    If Len(s) <> 8 Then
        IsEightDigits = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim k As Long, c As String
    For k = 1 To 8
        c = Mid(s, k, 1)
        If c < "0" Or c > "9" Then
            IsEightDigits = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next k

## Code review: SMS Broadcast changes (BroadcastBuilder.bas, CaseMatcher.bas, Helpers.bas)

**Critical bug — `CaseMatcher.bas:237`:** `IdentifySmsRequired` was refactored (adding `On Error GoTo Cleanup` / AutoFilter guards) and in the process the flag condition changed from `If isFcDone And isMcaf Then` to just `If isMcaf Then`. This drops the FC-DONE requirement entirely, contradicting both the function's own docstring and the design spec, which both say SMS REQUIRED needs *both* "FC DONE"/"PHONE FC DONE" **and** "MCAF REMINDER". `isFcDone` is computed but now unused — a strong tell this was accidental, not a deliberate spec change.

**Medium — `CaseMatcher.bas:334,336`:** `JoinPhoneFromEpic` wasn't fully converted to the new `SafeCStr` helper (unlike the rest of this changeset), still using raw `Trim(CStr(...))`. Combined with the newly added `On Error GoTo Cleanup`, an Excel error value in those cells would now silently abort the phone join for all remaining rows with no warning.

**Lower severity — `CaseMatcher.bas:41` (+2 other subs):** The new `On Error GoTo Cleanup` handlers swallow *any* runtime error silently (no MsgBox), a behavior change from before — errors used to surface via VBA's default dialog. Worth confirming this silent-failure mode is intentional, since it cuts against the design doc's "no case ever silently dropped" principle.

The `SafeCStr` introduction itself (guarding against Type Mismatch on `#N/A`/`#REF!`/Null/Empty) is a solid, well-targeted fix — the bug above is that its rollout in `IdentifySmsRequired` incidentally deleted the FC-DONE check, not that `SafeCStr` itself is wrong.

**Next step:** fix line 237 back to `If isFcDone And isMcaf Then` — that's the one I'd treat as blocking before this ships.

' Reads Task Description per row and appends an "MCAF Reminder" column with one of:
'   "SMS REQUIRED"                     -- FC DONE / PHONE FC DONE + MCAF REMINDER found
'   "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED" -- needs FC follow-up, not an SMS case
'   ""                                 -- neither pattern matched
' Direct port of the manual SOP's IF formula (SOP step 3) -- not re-derived.
' Phrase lists come from the Config sheet (MatchesAnyPhrase/LoadPhraseList,
' ConfigReader.bas), falling back to the hardcoded defaults below if Config
' is absent. "NO FC DONE" is checked first and excluded from the "FC DONE"
' match so the substring "FC DONE" inside "NO FC DONE" doesn't cause a
' false SMS REQUIRED.
Public Sub IdentifySmsRequired(wsEfc As Worksheet)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup

    If wsEfc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False

    Dim commentHeader As String, encHeader As String
    commentHeader = GetSetting("eFC Comment Header", "Task Description")
    encHeader = GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No")

    Dim commentCol As Long
    commentCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, commentHeader)
    If commentCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: eFC file is missing the '" & commentHeader & "' column.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, encHeader)
    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = wsEfc.Cells(1, wsEfc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    Dim mcafCol As Long
    mcafCol = lastCol + 1
    wsEfc.Cells(1, mcafCol).Value = "MCAF Reminder"

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim mcafPhrases() As String, mcafCount As Long
    Dim fcDonePhrases() As String, fcDoneCount As Long
    Dim noFcDonePhrases() As String, noFcDoneCount As Long
    Dim wardClassPhrases() As String, wardClassCount As Long
    LoadPhraseList "MCAF Reminder Phrases", Array("MCAF REMINDER"), mcafPhrases, mcafCount
    LoadPhraseList "FC Done Phrases", Array("FC DONE", "PHONE FC DONE"), fcDonePhrases, fcDoneCount
    LoadPhraseList "No FC Done Phrases", Array("NO FC DONE"), noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount
    LoadPhraseList "Ward Class Phrases", Array("WARD CLASS SELECTED"), wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount

    Dim commentData As Variant
    commentData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, commentCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, commentCol)).Value

    Dim flagOut() As Variant
    ReDim flagOut(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim i As Long, comment As String
    Dim isMcaf As Boolean, isNoFcDone As Boolean, isWardClass As Boolean, isFcDone As Boolean

    For i = 1 To UBound(commentData, 1)
        comment = UCase(Trim(SafeCStr(commentData(i, 1))))
        isMcaf = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, mcafPhrases, mcafCount)
        isNoFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount)
        isWardClass = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount)
        isFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, fcDonePhrases, fcDoneCount) And Not isNoFcDone

        If isMcaf Then
            flagOut(i, 1) = "SMS REQUIRED"
        ElseIf isNoFcDone Or isWardClass Then
            flagOut(i, 1) = "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED"
        Else
            flagOut(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, mcafCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, mcafCol)).Value = flagOut

Cleanup:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

Public Sub JoinPhoneFromEpic(wsEfc As Worksheet, wsEpic As Worksheet)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup

    If wsEfc Is Nothing Or wsEpic Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
    If wsEpic.AutoFilterMode Then wsEpic.AutoFilterMode = False

    Dim epicCSNCol As Long, epicPhoneCol As Long
    epicCSNCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic CSN Header", "CSN"))
    epicPhoneCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic Phone Header", "Phone"))
    If epicCSNCol = 0 Or epicPhoneCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: Epic file is missing required columns for the Phone join.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long, mcafCol As Long
    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
    mcafCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, "MCAF Reminder")
    If encCol = 0 Or mcafCol = 0 Then Exit Sub   ' IdentifySmsRequired hasn't run yet

    Dim lastRowEfc As Long
    lastRowEfc = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowEfc < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRowEpic As Long
    lastRowEpic = wsEpic.Cells(wsEpic.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowEpic < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' --- Bulk-load Epic into CSN-keyed dictionaries, one per candidate slot ---
    Dim epicLastCol As Long
    epicLastCol = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(epicCSNCol, epicPhoneCol)
    Dim epicData As Variant
    epicData = wsEpic.Range(wsEpic.Cells(1, 1), wsEpic.Cells(lastRowEpic, epicLastCol)).Value

    Dim dictPhone1 As Object, dictPhone2 As Object, dictPhone3 As Object
    Set dictPhone1 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictPhone2 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictPhone3 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, csn As String, p1 As String, p2 As String, p3 As String
    For i = 2 To lastRowEpic
        csn = SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicCSNCol))
        ExtractMobileNumbers SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicPhoneCol)), p1, p2, p3
        dictPhone1(csn) = p1
        dictPhone2(csn) = p2
        dictPhone3(csn) = p3
    Next i

    ' --- Append "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" right after "MCAF Reminder" ---
    Dim phone1OutCol As Long, phone2OutCol As Long, phone3OutCol As Long
    phone1OutCol = mcafCol + 1
    phone2OutCol = mcafCol + 2
    phone3OutCol = mcafCol + 3
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone1OutCol).Value = "1st Phone Number"
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone2OutCol).Value = "2nd Phone Number"
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone3OutCol).Value = "3rd Phone Number"

    Dim efcData As Variant
    efcData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, mcafCol)).Value

    Dim phone1Out() As Variant, phone2Out() As Variant, phone3Out() As Variant
    ReDim phone1Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
    ReDim phone2Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
    ReDim phone3Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim encNo As String, flag As String
    For i = 1 To UBound(efcData, 1)
        flag = SafeCStr(efcData(i, mcafCol))
        If flag = "SMS REQUIRED" Then
            encNo = SafeCStr(efcData(i, encCol))
            If dictPhone1.Exists(encNo) Then
                phone1Out(i, 1) = dictPhone1(encNo)
                phone2Out(i, 1) = dictPhone2(encNo)
                phone3Out(i, 1) = dictPhone3(encNo)
            Else
                phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
                phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
                phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
            End If
        Else
            phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
            phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
            phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone1OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone1OutCol)).Value = phone1Out
    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone2OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone2OutCol)).Value = phone2Out
    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone3OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone3OutCol)).Value = phone3Out

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True

484	' One matched or candidate SMS case, built by BuildReviewList (BroadcastBuilder.bas)
485	' from the flagged eFC working sheet. Fields match the columns actually used
486	' from the SMS TEMPLATE workbook (confirmed 2026-07-21): Encounter No, MRN,
487	' Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number (all three raw candidates, not
488	' collapsed to one -- so PSA can see and override what the tool would pick;
489	' see FirstUsableNumber). FC ID / Admission Date / Admission Status and the
490	' FTF/SMS checker column onward are disregarded -- not part of the real
491	' working process. No separate Bed field either (see JoinPhoneFromEpic).
492	Public Type SmsCase
493	    EncounterNo As String
494	    MRN As String
495	    PatientName As String
496	    Phone1 As String
497	    Phone2 As String
498	    Phone3 As String
499	End Type
500	
501	' Collapses repeat Encounter No rows in wsEfc, keeping only the LAST occurrence
502	' (bottom-most row in file order) per Encounter No -- see the Dedup Rule in the
503	' design spec: a repeat most plausibly means a re-export after a correction,
504	' and later rows reflect the more recent state.
505	' dupSummary receives one description string per collapsed Encounter No
506	' ("<EncounterNo> (<N> occurrences collapsed)"); dupCount is the number of
507	' distinct Encounter Nos affected (not the number of rows removed).
508	' Load-filter-write-delete strategy: one read, one write, one delete.
509	Public Sub DedupeEfcRows(wsEfc As Worksheet, ByRef dupSummary() As String, ByRef dupCount As Long)
510	    On Error GoTo Cleanup
511	
512	    dupCount = 0
513	    ReDim dupSummary(1 To 0)
514	
515	    If wsEfc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
516	
517	    ' Clear AutoFilter if active so hidden rows don't interfere or freeze delete operations
518	    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
519	
520	    Dim encCol As Long
521	    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
522	    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
523	
524	    Dim lastRow As Long
525	    lastRow = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
526	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
527	
528	    Dim lastCol As Long
529	    lastCol = wsEfc.Cells(1, wsEfc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
530	    If lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub
531	
532	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
533	
534	    Dim allData As Variant
535	    allData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(1, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value
536	
537	    ' --- Pass 1: last row index and occurrence count per Encounter No ---
538	    Dim lastIdx As Object, occCount As Object
539	    Set lastIdx = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
540	    Set occCount = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
541	
542	    Dim i As Long, key As String
543	    For i = 2 To lastRow
544	        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
545	        If key <> "" Then
546	            lastIdx(key) = i
547	            If occCount.Exists(key) Then
548	                occCount(key) = occCount(key) + 1
549	            Else
550	                occCount(key) = 1
551	            End If
552	        End If
553	    Next i
554	
555	    ' --- Pass 2: count rows to keep (blank keys always kept -- can't dedupe safely) ---
556	    Dim keepCount As Long
557	    keepCount = 0
558	    For i = 2 To lastRow
559	        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
560	        If key = "" Then
561	            keepCount = keepCount + 1
562	        ElseIf lastIdx(key) = i Then
563	            keepCount = keepCount + 1
564	        End If
565	    Next i
566	
567	    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
568	        GoTo Cleanup   ' nothing to collapse
569	    End If
570	
571	    ' --- Pass 3: build the compacted array of kept rows ---
572	    Dim filtData() As Variant
573	    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)
574	    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
575	    outRow = 0
576	    For i = 2 To lastRow
577	        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
578	        If key = "" Or lastIdx(key) = i Then
579	            outRow = outRow + 1
580	            For j = 1 To lastCol
581	                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
582	            Next j
583	        End If
584	    Next i
585	
586	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData
587	    Dim newLastRow As Long
588	    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
589	    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
590	        wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(newLastRow + 1, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Clear
591	    End If
592	
593	    ' --- Build the dup summary from keys with more than one occurrence ---
594	    Dim k As Variant
595	    For Each k In occCount.Keys
596	        If occCount(k) > 1 Then
597	            dupCount = dupCount + 1
598	            ReDim Preserve dupSummary(1 To dupCount)
599	            dupSummary(dupCount) = SafeCStr(k) & " (" & occCount(k) & " occurrences collapsed)"
600	        End If
601	    Next k
602	
603	Cleanup:
604	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
605	End Sub
606	
607	' Returns True if comment contains any of phrases(1..phraseCount) as a
608	' substring. comment must already be UCase'd by the caller.
609	Public Function MatchesAnyPhrase(comment As String, phrases() As String, phraseCount As Long) As Boolean
610	    Dim i As Long
611	    For i = 1 To phraseCount
612	        If InStr(comment, phrases(i)) > 0 Then
613	            MatchesAnyPhrase = True
614	            Exit Function
615	        End If
616	    Next i
617	    MatchesAnyPhrase = False
618	End Function
619	
620	' Loads a Config phrase/value list by header name, falling back to defaults
621	' (pass as Array("A", "B", ...)) if the Config sheet or that column is
622	' missing/empty. Callers load once, before a per-row loop -- see
623	' IdentifySmsRequired -- never re-reading Config per row.
624	Public Sub LoadPhraseList(configHeader As String, defaults As Variant, ByRef outList() As String, ByRef outCount As Long)
625	    outList = ReadConfigList(configHeader, outCount)
626	    If outCount = 0 Then
627	        Dim n As Long
628	        n = UBound(defaults) - LBound(defaults) + 1
629	        ReDim outList(1 To n)
630	        Dim i As Long
631	        For i = 1 To n
632	            outList(i) = SafeCStr(defaults(LBound(defaults) + i - 1))
633	        Next i
634	        outCount = n
635	    End If
636	End Sub
637	
638	' Reads Task Description per row and appends an "MCAF Reminder" column with one of:
639	'   "SMS REQUIRED"                     -- FC DONE / PHONE FC DONE + MCAF REMINDER found
640	'   "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED" -- needs FC follow-up, not an SMS case
641	'   ""                                 -- neither pattern matched
642	' Direct port of the manual SOP's IF formula (SOP step 3) -- not re-derived.
643	' Phrase lists come from the Config sheet (MatchesAnyPhrase/LoadPhraseList,
644	' ConfigReader.bas), falling back to the hardcoded defaults below if Config
645	' is absent. "NO FC DONE" is checked first and excluded from the "FC DONE"
646	' match so the substring "FC DONE" inside "NO FC DONE" doesn't cause a
647	' false SMS REQUIRED.
648	Public Sub IdentifySmsRequired(wsEfc As Worksheet)
649	    On Error GoTo Cleanup
650	
651	    If wsEfc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
652	    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
653	
654	    Dim commentHeader As String, encHeader As String
655	    commentHeader = GetSetting("eFC Comment Header", "Task Description")
656	    encHeader = GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No")
657	
658	    Dim commentCol As Long
659	    commentCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, commentHeader)
660	    If commentCol = 0 Then
661	        MsgBox "Error: eFC file is missing the '" & commentHeader & "' column.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
662	        Exit Sub
663	    End If
664	
665	    Dim encCol As Long
666	    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, encHeader)
667	    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub
668	
669	    Dim lastRow As Long
670	    lastRow = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
671	    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub
672	
673	    Dim lastCol As Long
674	    lastCol = wsEfc.Cells(1, wsEfc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
675	    Dim mcafCol As Long
676	    mcafCol = lastCol + 1
677	    wsEfc.Cells(1, mcafCol).Value = "MCAF Reminder"
678	
679	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
680	
681	    Dim mcafPhrases() As String, mcafCount As Long
682	    Dim fcDonePhrases() As String, fcDoneCount As Long
683	    Dim noFcDonePhrases() As String, noFcDoneCount As Long
684	    Dim wardClassPhrases() As String, wardClassCount As Long
685	    LoadPhraseList "MCAF Reminder Phrases", Array("MCAF REMINDER"), mcafPhrases, mcafCount
686	    LoadPhraseList "FC Done Phrases", Array("FC DONE", "PHONE FC DONE"), fcDonePhrases, fcDoneCount
687	    LoadPhraseList "No FC Done Phrases", Array("NO FC DONE"), noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount
688	    LoadPhraseList "Ward Class Phrases", Array("WARD CLASS SELECTED"), wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount
689	
690	    Dim commentData As Variant
691	    commentData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, commentCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, commentCol)).Value
692	
693	    Dim flagOut() As Variant
694	    ReDim flagOut(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)
695	
696	    Dim i As Long, comment As String
697	    Dim isMcaf As Boolean, isNoFcDone As Boolean, isWardClass As Boolean, isFcDone As Boolean
698	
699	    For i = 1 To UBound(commentData, 1)
700	        comment = UCase(Trim(SafeCStr(commentData(i, 1))))
701	        isMcaf = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, mcafPhrases, mcafCount)
702	        isNoFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount)
703	        isWardClass = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount)
704	        isFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, fcDonePhrases, fcDoneCount) And Not isNoFcDone
705	
706	        If isMcaf Then
707	            flagOut(i, 1) = "SMS REQUIRED"
708	        ElseIf isNoFcDone Or isWardClass Then
709	            flagOut(i, 1) = "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED"
710	        Else
711	            flagOut(i, 1) = ""
712	        End If
713	    Next i
714	
715	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, mcafCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, mcafCol)).Value = flagOut
716	
717	Cleanup:
718	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
719	End Sub
720	
721	' For every row flagged "SMS REQUIRED" by IdentifySmsRequired, looks up Phone
722	' from wsEpic by CSN = Encounter No (constraint #4 in the design spec) and
723	' writes it into three new "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" columns appended after
724	' "MCAF Reminder" -- matching the SMS TEMPLATE's own H/I/J columns (all three
725	' raw candidates, not collapsed to one; see ExtractMobileNumbers). No Bed
726	' lookup -- dropped 2026-07-21: the columns actually used from the SMS
727	' TEMPLATE (Encounter No, MRN, Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number) don't
728	' include Bed, so there was nothing for a Bed value to feed. Rows with no
729	' Epic match are left blank on all three -- BuildReviewList
730	' (BroadcastBuilder.bas) already routes any row with no usable candidate to
731	' "Needs Manual Lookup" rather than dropping it. Bulk dictionary join, same
732	' pattern as the MFC macro's Epic lookup (EpicLookup.bas) -- one bulk read of
733	' Epic, one pass over eFC.
734	Public Sub JoinPhoneFromEpic(wsEfc As Worksheet, wsEpic As Worksheet)
735	    On Error GoTo Cleanup
736	
737	    If wsEfc Is Nothing Or wsEpic Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
738	    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
739	    If wsEpic.AutoFilterMode Then wsEpic.AutoFilterMode = False
740	
741	    Dim epicCSNCol As Long, epicPhoneCol As Long
742	    epicCSNCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic CSN Header", "CSN"))
743	    epicPhoneCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic Phone Header", "Phone"))
744	    If epicCSNCol = 0 Or epicPhoneCol = 0 Then
745	        MsgBox "Error: Epic file is missing required columns for the Phone join.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
746	        Exit Sub
747	    End If
748	
749	    Dim encCol As Long, mcafCol As Long
750	    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
751	    mcafCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, "MCAF Reminder")
752	    If encCol = 0 Or mcafCol = 0 Then Exit Sub   ' IdentifySmsRequired hasn't run yet
753	
754	    Dim lastRowEfc As Long
755	    lastRowEfc = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
756	    If lastRowEfc < 2 Then Exit Sub
757	
758	    Dim lastRowEpic As Long
759	    lastRowEpic = wsEpic.Cells(wsEpic.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
760	    If lastRowEpic < 2 Then Exit Sub
761	
762	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
763	
764	    ' --- Bulk-load Epic into CSN-keyed dictionaries, one per candidate slot ---
765	    Dim epicLastCol As Long
766	    epicLastCol = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(epicCSNCol, epicPhoneCol)
767	    Dim epicData As Variant
768	    epicData = wsEpic.Range(wsEpic.Cells(1, 1), wsEpic.Cells(lastRowEpic, epicLastCol)).Value
769	
770	    Dim dictPhone1 As Object, dictPhone2 As Object, dictPhone3 As Object
771	    Set dictPhone1 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
772	    Set dictPhone2 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
773	    Set dictPhone3 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
774	
775	    Dim i As Long, csn As String, p1 As String, p2 As String, p3 As String
776	    For i = 2 To lastRowEpic
777	        csn = SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicCSNCol))
778	        ExtractMobileNumbers SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicPhoneCol)), p1, p2, p3
779	        dictPhone1(csn) = p1
780	        dictPhone2(csn) = p2
781	        dictPhone3(csn) = p3
782	    Next i
783	
784	    ' --- Append "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" right after "MCAF Reminder" ---
785	    Dim phone1OutCol As Long, phone2OutCol As Long, phone3OutCol As Long
786	    phone1OutCol = mcafCol + 1
787	    phone2OutCol = mcafCol + 2
788	    phone3OutCol = mcafCol + 3
789	    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone1OutCol).Value = "1st Phone Number"
790	    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone2OutCol).Value = "2nd Phone Number"
791	    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone3OutCol).Value = "3rd Phone Number"
792	
793	    Dim efcData As Variant
794	    efcData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, mcafCol)).Value
795	
796	    Dim phone1Out() As Variant, phone2Out() As Variant, phone3Out() As Variant
797	    ReDim phone1Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
798	    ReDim phone2Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
799	    ReDim phone3Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
800	
801	    Dim encNo As String, flag As String
802	    For i = 1 To UBound(efcData, 1)
803	        flag = Trim(CStr(efcData(i, mcafCol)))
804	        If flag = "SMS REQUIRED" Then
805	            encNo = Trim(CStr(efcData(i, encCol)))
806	            If dictPhone1.Exists(encNo) Then
807	                phone1Out(i, 1) = dictPhone1(encNo)
808	                phone2Out(i, 1) = dictPhone2(encNo)
809	                phone3Out(i, 1) = dictPhone3(encNo)
810	            Else
811	                phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
812	                phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
813	                phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
814	            End If
815	        Else
816	            phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
817	            phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
818	            phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
819	        End If
820	    Next i
821	
822	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone1OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone1OutCol)).Value = phone1Out
823	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone2OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone2OutCol)).Value = phone2Out
824	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone3OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone3OutCol)).Value = phone3Out
825	
826	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
827	End Sub
828	
829	' Ports the SMS TEMPLATE workbook's "1st/2nd/3rd phone number" formulas
830	' (columns H/I/J): Epic's raw phone field looks like
831	'   "*9327 2613 (Mobile)" & vbCrLf & "6677 1216 (Home Phone)" & vbCrLf & "9664 9678 (Work Phone)"
832	' -- one or more labelled numbers, asterisks marking a preferred number, and
833	' line breaks between entries. Strips spaces and asterisks (matching the
834	' template's inline SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(G2," ",""),"*","") step), then scans
835	' left to right for up to three non-overlapping 8-digit runs starting with
836	' "8" or "9" (the SG mobile prefixes), writing them into num1/num2/num3 in
837	' the order found. Deliberately does NOT reject Epic's "88888888"/"99999999"
838	' placeholder values here -- those are still valid *candidates* to show a
839	' human reviewer (see ReviewForm), same as the template's own H/I/J don't
840	' filter them either. Use FirstUsableNumber to pick one for the broadcast file.
841	Public Sub ExtractMobileNumbers(rawPhone As String, ByRef num1 As String, ByRef num2 As String, ByRef num3 As String)
842	    num1 = ""
843	    num2 = ""
844	    num3 = ""
845	
846	    Dim cleaned As String
847	    cleaned = Replace(rawPhone, " ", "")
848	    cleaned = Replace(cleaned, "*", "")
849	
850	    Dim n As Long
851	    n = Len(cleaned)
852	
853	    Dim found As Long
854	    found = 0
855	
856	    Dim i As Long, ch As String, candidate As String
857	    i = 1
858	    Do While i <= n - 7 And found < 3
859	        ch = Mid(cleaned, i, 1)
860	        If ch = "8" Or ch = "9" Then
861	            candidate = Mid(cleaned, i, 8)
862	            If IsEightDigits(candidate) Then
863	                found = found + 1
864	                Select Case found
865	                    Case 1: num1 = candidate
866	                    Case 2: num2 = candidate
867	                    Case 3: num3 = candidate
868	                End Select
869	                i = i + 8   ' non-overlapping: skip past this candidate
870	            Else
871	                i = i + 1
872	            End If
873	        Else
874	            i = i + 1
875	        End If
876	    Loop
877	End Sub
878	
879	' Loads the "Epic Placeholder Numbers" Config list once (falls back to
880	' 88888888/99999999) -- callers pass the result into FirstUsableNumber so a
881	' bulk-processing loop doesn't re-read Config per row.
882	Public Sub LoadPlaceholderList(ByRef outList() As String, ByRef outCount As Long)
883	    LoadPhraseList "Epic Placeholder Numbers", Array("88888888", "99999999"), outList, outCount
884	End Sub
885	
886	' Picks the single number that goes into the final broadcast file (SOP step
887	' 5/9 requires exactly one "Mobile Number" per row) -- the first of the
888	' three candidates that isn't blank or a configured placeholder value.
889	' ReviewForm still shows all three raw candidates so PSA can see and
890	' override what got picked, rather than this decision being made invisibly.
891	Public Function FirstUsableNumber(num1 As String, num2 As String, num3 As String, _
892	                                   placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As String
893	    If IsUsableNumber(num1, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
894	        FirstUsableNumber = num1
895	    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num2, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
896	        FirstUsableNumber = num2
897	    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num3, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
898	        FirstUsableNumber = num3
899	    Else
900	        FirstUsableNumber = ""
901	    End If
902	End Function
903	
904	Private Function IsUsableNumber(num As String, placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As Boolean
905	    If num = "" Then
906	        IsUsableNumber = False
907	        Exit Function
908	    End If
909	
910	    Dim i As Long
911	    For i = 1 To placeholderCount
912	        If num = placeholders(i) Then
913	            IsUsableNumber = False
914	            Exit Function
915	        End If
916	    Next i
917	
918	    IsUsableNumber = True
919	End Function
920	
921	' True if s is exactly 8 characters, all digits 0-9.
922	Private Function IsEightDigits(s As String) As Boolean
923	    If Len(s) <> 8 Then
924	        IsEightDigits = False
925	        Exit Function
926	    End If
927	
928	    Dim k As Long, c As String
929	    For k = 1 To 8
930	        c = Mid(s, k, 1)
931	        If c < "0" Or c > "9" Then
932	            IsEightDigits = False
933	            Exit Function
934	        End If
935	    Next k
936	
937	    IsEightDigits = True
938	End Function
939	
940	
941	============================================================

============================================================
MODULE: CaseMatcher.bas
============================================================

Attribute VB_Name = "CaseMatcher"
Option Explicit

' ============================================================
' CaseMatcher.bas
'
' Ports the manual SOP's case-identification and Epic join logic:
'   DedupeEfcRows       -- collapse repeat Encounter No rows, keep last occurrence
'   IdentifySmsRequired -- Comment string match, ports the existing IF formula
'   JoinPhoneFromEpic   -- CSN/Encounter No dictionary join against Epic
' See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-16-sms-broadcast-design.md for the
' identification rules and the dedup rationale.
' ============================================================

' One matched or candidate SMS case, built by BuildReviewList (BroadcastBuilder.bas)
' from the flagged eFC working sheet. Fields match the columns actually used
' from the SMS TEMPLATE workbook (confirmed 2026-07-21): Encounter No, MRN,
' Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number (all three raw candidates, not
' collapsed to one -- so PSA can see and override what the tool would pick;
' see FirstUsableNumber). FC ID / Admission Date / Admission Status and the
' FTF/SMS checker column onward are disregarded -- not part of the real
' working process. No separate Bed field either (see JoinPhoneFromEpic).
Public Type SmsCase
    EncounterNo As String
    MRN As String
    PatientName As String
    Phone1 As String
    Phone2 As String
    Phone3 As String
End Type

' Collapses repeat Encounter No rows in wsEfc, keeping only the LAST occurrence
' (bottom-most row in file order) per Encounter No -- see the Dedup Rule in the
' design spec: a repeat most plausibly means a re-export after a correction,
' and later rows reflect the more recent state.
' dupSummary receives one description string per collapsed Encounter No
' ("<EncounterNo> (<N> occurrences collapsed)"); dupCount is the number of
' distinct Encounter Nos affected (not the number of rows removed).
' Load-filter-write-delete strategy: one read, one write, one delete.
Public Sub DedupeEfcRows(wsEfc As Worksheet, ByRef dupSummary() As String, ByRef dupCount As Long)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup

    dupCount = 0
    ReDim dupSummary(1 To 0)

    If wsEfc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub

    ' Clear AutoFilter if active so hidden rows don't interfere or freeze delete operations
    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = wsEfc.Cells(1, wsEfc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    If lastCol < 1 Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim allData As Variant
    allData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(1, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Value

    ' --- Pass 1: last row index and occurrence count per Encounter No ---
    Dim lastIdx As Object, occCount As Object
    Set lastIdx = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set occCount = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, key As String
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
        If key <> "" Then
            lastIdx(key) = i
            If occCount.Exists(key) Then
                occCount(key) = occCount(key) + 1
            Else
                occCount(key) = 1
            End If
        End If
    Next i

    ' --- Pass 2: count rows to keep (blank keys always kept -- can't dedupe safely) ---
    Dim keepCount As Long
    keepCount = 0
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
        If key = "" Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        ElseIf lastIdx(key) = i Then
            keepCount = keepCount + 1
        End If
    Next i

    If keepCount = lastRow - 1 Then
        GoTo Cleanup   ' nothing to collapse
    End If

    ' --- Pass 3: build the compacted array of kept rows ---
    Dim filtData() As Variant
    ReDim filtData(1 To keepCount, 1 To lastCol)
    Dim outRow As Long, j As Long
    outRow = 0
    For i = 2 To lastRow
        key = SafeCStr(allData(i, encCol))
        If key = "" Or lastIdx(key) = i Then
            outRow = outRow + 1
            For j = 1 To lastCol
                filtData(outRow, j) = allData(i, j)
            Next j
        End If
    Next i

    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(1 + keepCount, lastCol)).Value = filtData
    Dim newLastRow As Long
    newLastRow = 1 + keepCount
    If newLastRow < lastRow Then
        wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(newLastRow + 1, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, lastCol)).Clear
    End If

    ' --- Build the dup summary from keys with more than one occurrence ---
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In occCount.Keys
        If occCount(k) > 1 Then
            dupCount = dupCount + 1
            ReDim Preserve dupSummary(1 To dupCount)
            dupSummary(dupCount) = SafeCStr(k) & " (" & occCount(k) & " occurrences collapsed)"
        End If
    Next k

Cleanup:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

' Returns True if comment contains any of phrases(1..phraseCount) as a
' substring. comment must already be UCase'd by the caller.
Public Function MatchesAnyPhrase(comment As String, phrases() As String, phraseCount As Long) As Boolean
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To phraseCount
        If InStr(comment, phrases(i)) > 0 Then
            MatchesAnyPhrase = True
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
    MatchesAnyPhrase = False
End Function

' Loads a Config phrase/value list by header name, falling back to defaults
' (pass as Array("A", "B", ...)) if the Config sheet or that column is
' missing/empty. Callers load once, before a per-row loop -- see
' IdentifySmsRequired -- never re-reading Config per row.
Public Sub LoadPhraseList(configHeader As String, defaults As Variant, ByRef outList() As String, ByRef outCount As Long)
    outList = ReadConfigList(configHeader, outCount)
    If outCount = 0 Then
        Dim n As Long
        n = UBound(defaults) - LBound(defaults) + 1
        ReDim outList(1 To n)
        Dim i As Long
        For i = 1 To n
            outList(i) = SafeCStr(defaults(LBound(defaults) + i - 1))
        Next i
        outCount = n
    End If
End Sub

' Reads Task Description per row and appends an "MCAF Reminder" column with one of:
'   "SMS REQUIRED"                     -- FC DONE / PHONE FC DONE + MCAF REMINDER found
'   "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED" -- needs FC follow-up, not an SMS case
'   ""                                 -- neither pattern matched
' Direct port of the manual SOP's IF formula (SOP step 3) -- not re-derived.
' Phrase lists come from the Config sheet (MatchesAnyPhrase/LoadPhraseList,
' ConfigReader.bas), falling back to the hardcoded defaults below if Config
' is absent. "NO FC DONE" is checked first and excluded from the "FC DONE"
' match so the substring "FC DONE" inside "NO FC DONE" doesn't cause a
' false SMS REQUIRED.
Public Sub IdentifySmsRequired(wsEfc As Worksheet)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup

    If wsEfc Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False

    Dim commentHeader As String, encHeader As String
    commentHeader = GetSetting("eFC Comment Header", "Task Description")
    encHeader = GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No")

    Dim commentCol As Long
    commentCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, commentHeader)
    If commentCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: eFC file is missing the '" & commentHeader & "' column.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long
    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, encHeader)
    If encCol = 0 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRow As Long
    lastRow = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRow < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastCol As Long
    lastCol = wsEfc.Cells(1, wsEfc.Columns.Count).End(xlToLeft).Column
    Dim mcafCol As Long
    mcafCol = lastCol + 1
    wsEfc.Cells(1, mcafCol).Value = "MCAF Reminder"

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    Dim mcafPhrases() As String, mcafCount As Long
    Dim fcDonePhrases() As String, fcDoneCount As Long
    Dim noFcDonePhrases() As String, noFcDoneCount As Long
    Dim wardClassPhrases() As String, wardClassCount As Long
    LoadPhraseList "MCAF Reminder Phrases", Array("MCAF REMINDER"), mcafPhrases, mcafCount
    LoadPhraseList "FC Done Phrases", Array("FC DONE", "PHONE FC DONE"), fcDonePhrases, fcDoneCount
    LoadPhraseList "No FC Done Phrases", Array("NO FC DONE"), noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount
    LoadPhraseList "Ward Class Phrases", Array("WARD CLASS SELECTED"), wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount

    Dim commentData As Variant
    commentData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, commentCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, commentCol)).Value

    Dim flagOut() As Variant
    ReDim flagOut(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim i As Long, comment As String
    Dim isMcaf As Boolean, isNoFcDone As Boolean, isWardClass As Boolean, isFcDone As Boolean

    For i = 1 To UBound(commentData, 1)
        comment = UCase(Trim(SafeCStr(commentData(i, 1))))
        isMcaf = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, mcafPhrases, mcafCount)
        isNoFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount)
        isWardClass = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount)
        isFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, fcDonePhrases, fcDoneCount) And Not isNoFcDone

        If isMcaf Then
            flagOut(i, 1) = "SMS REQUIRED"
        ElseIf isNoFcDone Or isWardClass Then
            flagOut(i, 1) = "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED"
        Else
            flagOut(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, mcafCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, mcafCol)).Value = flagOut

Cleanup:
    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

' For every row flagged "SMS REQUIRED" by IdentifySmsRequired, looks up Phone
' from wsEpic by CSN = Encounter No (constraint #4 in the design spec) and
' writes it into three new "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" columns appended after
' "MCAF Reminder" -- matching the SMS TEMPLATE's own H/I/J columns (all three
' raw candidates, not collapsed to one; see ExtractMobileNumbers). No Bed
' lookup -- dropped 2026-07-21: the columns actually used from the SMS
' TEMPLATE (Encounter No, MRN, Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number) don't
' include Bed, so there was nothing for a Bed value to feed. Rows with no
' Epic match are left blank on all three -- BuildReviewList
' (BroadcastBuilder.bas) already routes any row with no usable candidate to
' "Needs Manual Lookup" rather than dropping it. Bulk dictionary join, same
' pattern as the MFC macro's Epic lookup (EpicLookup.bas) -- one bulk read of
' Epic, one pass over eFC.
Public Sub JoinPhoneFromEpic(wsEfc As Worksheet, wsEpic As Worksheet)
    On Error GoTo Cleanup

    If wsEfc Is Nothing Or wsEpic Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
    If wsEpic.AutoFilterMode Then wsEpic.AutoFilterMode = False

    Dim epicCSNCol As Long, epicPhoneCol As Long
    epicCSNCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic CSN Header", "CSN"))
    epicPhoneCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic Phone Header", "Phone"))
    If epicCSNCol = 0 Or epicPhoneCol = 0 Then
        MsgBox "Error: Epic file is missing required columns for the Phone join.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
        Exit Sub
    End If

    Dim encCol As Long, mcafCol As Long
    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
    mcafCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, "MCAF Reminder")
    If encCol = 0 Or mcafCol = 0 Then Exit Sub   ' IdentifySmsRequired hasn't run yet

    Dim lastRowEfc As Long
    lastRowEfc = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowEfc < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Dim lastRowEpic As Long
    lastRowEpic = wsEpic.Cells(wsEpic.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
    If lastRowEpic < 2 Then Exit Sub

    Application.ScreenUpdating = False

    ' --- Bulk-load Epic into CSN-keyed dictionaries, one per candidate slot ---
    Dim epicLastCol As Long
    epicLastCol = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(epicCSNCol, epicPhoneCol)
    Dim epicData As Variant
    epicData = wsEpic.Range(wsEpic.Cells(1, 1), wsEpic.Cells(lastRowEpic, epicLastCol)).Value

    Dim dictPhone1 As Object, dictPhone2 As Object, dictPhone3 As Object
    Set dictPhone1 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictPhone2 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
    Set dictPhone3 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")

    Dim i As Long, csn As String, p1 As String, p2 As String, p3 As String
    For i = 2 To lastRowEpic
        csn = SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicCSNCol))
        ExtractMobileNumbers SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicPhoneCol)), p1, p2, p3
        dictPhone1(csn) = p1
        dictPhone2(csn) = p2
        dictPhone3(csn) = p3
    Next i

    ' --- Append "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" right after "MCAF Reminder" ---
    Dim phone1OutCol As Long, phone2OutCol As Long, phone3OutCol As Long
    phone1OutCol = mcafCol + 1
    phone2OutCol = mcafCol + 2
    phone3OutCol = mcafCol + 3
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone1OutCol).Value = "1st Phone Number"
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone2OutCol).Value = "2nd Phone Number"
    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone3OutCol).Value = "3rd Phone Number"

    Dim efcData As Variant
    efcData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, mcafCol)).Value

    Dim phone1Out() As Variant, phone2Out() As Variant, phone3Out() As Variant
    ReDim phone1Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
    ReDim phone2Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
    ReDim phone3Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)

    Dim encNo As String, flag As String
    For i = 1 To UBound(efcData, 1)
        flag = Trim(CStr(efcData(i, mcafCol)))
        If flag = "SMS REQUIRED" Then
            encNo = Trim(CStr(efcData(i, encCol)))
            If dictPhone1.Exists(encNo) Then
                phone1Out(i, 1) = dictPhone1(encNo)
                phone2Out(i, 1) = dictPhone2(encNo)
                phone3Out(i, 1) = dictPhone3(encNo)
            Else
                phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
                phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
                phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
            End If
        Else
            phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
            phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
            phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
        End If
    Next i

    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone1OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone1OutCol)).Value = phone1Out
    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone2OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone2OutCol)).Value = phone2Out
    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone3OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone3OutCol)).Value = phone3Out

    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
End Sub

' Ports the SMS TEMPLATE workbook's "1st/2nd/3rd phone number" formulas
' (columns H/I/J): Epic's raw phone field looks like
'   "*9327 2613 (Mobile)" & vbCrLf & "6677 1216 (Home Phone)" & vbCrLf & "9664 9678 (Work Phone)"
' -- one or more labelled numbers, asterisks marking a preferred number, and
' line breaks between entries. Strips spaces and asterisks (matching the
' template's inline SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(G2," ",""),"*","") step), then scans
' left to right for up to three non-overlapping 8-digit runs starting with
' "8" or "9" (the SG mobile prefixes), writing them into num1/num2/num3 in
' the order found. Deliberately does NOT reject Epic's "88888888"/"99999999"
' placeholder values here -- those are still valid *candidates* to show a
' human reviewer (see ReviewForm), same as the template's own H/I/J don't
' filter them either. Use FirstUsableNumber to pick one for the broadcast file.
Public Sub ExtractMobileNumbers(rawPhone As String, ByRef num1 As String, ByRef num2 As String, ByRef num3 As String)
    num1 = ""
    num2 = ""
    num3 = ""

    Dim cleaned As String
    cleaned = Replace(rawPhone, " ", "")
    cleaned = Replace(cleaned, "*", "")

    Dim n As Long
    n = Len(cleaned)

    Dim found As Long
    found = 0

    Dim i As Long, ch As String, candidate As String
    i = 1
    Do While i <= n - 7 And found < 3
        ch = Mid(cleaned, i, 1)
        If ch = "8" Or ch = "9" Then
            candidate = Mid(cleaned, i, 8)
            If IsEightDigits(candidate) Then
                found = found + 1
                Select Case found
                    Case 1: num1 = candidate
                    Case 2: num2 = candidate
                    Case 3: num3 = candidate
                End Select
                i = i + 8   ' non-overlapping: skip past this candidate
            Else
                i = i + 1
            End If
        Else
            i = i + 1
        End If
    Loop
End Sub

' Loads the "Epic Placeholder Numbers" Config list once (falls back to
' 88888888/99999999) -- callers pass the result into FirstUsableNumber so a
' bulk-processing loop doesn't re-read Config per row.
Public Sub LoadPlaceholderList(ByRef outList() As String, ByRef outCount As Long)
    LoadPhraseList "Epic Placeholder Numbers", Array("88888888", "99999999"), outList, outCount
End Sub

' Picks the single number that goes into the final broadcast file (SOP step
' 5/9 requires exactly one "Mobile Number" per row) -- the first of the
' three candidates that isn't blank or a configured placeholder value.
' ReviewForm still shows all three raw candidates so PSA can see and
' override what got picked, rather than this decision being made invisibly.
Public Function FirstUsableNumber(num1 As String, num2 As String, num3 As String, _
                                   placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As String
    If IsUsableNumber(num1, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
        FirstUsableNumber = num1
    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num2, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
        FirstUsableNumber = num2
    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num3, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
        FirstUsableNumber = num3
    Else
        FirstUsableNumber = ""
    End If
End Function

Private Function IsUsableNumber(num As String, placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As Boolean
    If num = "" Then
        IsUsableNumber = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To placeholderCount
        If num = placeholders(i) Then
            IsUsableNumber = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i

    IsUsableNumber = True
End Function

' True if s is exactly 8 characters, all digits 0-9.
Private Function IsEightDigits(s As String) As Boolean
    If Len(s) <> 8 Then
        IsEightDigits = False
        Exit Function
    End If

    Dim k As Long, c As String
    For k = 1 To 8
        c = Mid(s, k, 1)
        If c < "0" Or c > "9" Then
            IsEightDigits = False
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next k

    IsEightDigits = True
End Function

210	    mcafCol = lastCol + 1
211	    wsEfc.Cells(1, mcafCol).Value = "MCAF Reminder"
212	
213	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
214	
215	    Dim mcafPhrases() As String, mcafCount As Long
216	    Dim noFcDonePhrases() As String, noFcDoneCount As Long
217	    Dim wardClassPhrases() As String, wardClassCount As Long
218	    LoadPhraseList "MCAF Reminder Phrases", Array("MCAF REMINDER"), mcafPhrases, mcafCount
219	    LoadPhraseList "No FC Done Phrases", Array("NO FC DONE"), noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount
220	    LoadPhraseList "Ward Class Phrases", Array("WARD CLASS SELECTED"), wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount
221	
222	    Dim commentData As Variant
223	    commentData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, commentCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, commentCol)).Value
224	
225	    Dim flagOut() As Variant
226	    ReDim flagOut(1 To lastRow - 1, 1 To 1)
227	
228	    Dim i As Long, comment As String
229	    Dim isMcaf As Boolean, isNoFcDone As Boolean, isWardClass As Boolean
230	
231	    For i = 1 To UBound(commentData, 1)
232	        comment = UCase(Trim(SafeCStr(commentData(i, 1))))
233	        isMcaf = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, mcafPhrases, mcafCount)
234	        isNoFcDone = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, noFcDonePhrases, noFcDoneCount)
235	        isWardClass = MatchesAnyPhrase(comment, wardClassPhrases, wardClassCount)
236	
237	        If isMcaf Then
238	            flagOut(i, 1) = "SMS REQUIRED"
239	        ElseIf isNoFcDone Or isWardClass Then
240	            flagOut(i, 1) = "NO FC DONE / WARD CLASS SELECTED"
241	        Else
242	            flagOut(i, 1) = ""
243	        End If
244	    Next i
245	
246	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, mcafCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRow, mcafCol)).Value = flagOut
247	
248	Cleanup:
249	    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
250	        MsgBox "Error in IdentifySmsRequired: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Unexpected Error"
251	    End If
252	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
253	End Sub
254	
255	' For every row flagged "SMS REQUIRED" by IdentifySmsRequired, looks up Phone
256	' from wsEpic by CSN = Encounter No (constraint #4 in the design spec) and
257	' writes it into three new "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" columns appended after
258	' "MCAF Reminder" -- matching the SMS TEMPLATE's own H/I/J columns (all three
259	' raw candidates, not collapsed to one; see ExtractMobileNumbers). No Bed
260	' lookup -- dropped 2026-07-21: the columns actually used from the SMS
261	' TEMPLATE (Encounter No, MRN, Patient Name, 1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number) don't
262	' include Bed, so there was nothing for a Bed value to feed. Rows with no
263	' Epic match are left blank on all three -- BuildReviewList
264	' (BroadcastBuilder.bas) already routes any row with no usable candidate to
265	' "Needs Manual Lookup" rather than dropping it. Bulk dictionary join, same
266	' pattern as the MFC macro's Epic lookup (EpicLookup.bas) -- one bulk read of
267	' Epic, one pass over eFC.
268	Public Sub JoinPhoneFromEpic(wsEfc As Worksheet, wsEpic As Worksheet)
269	    On Error GoTo Cleanup
270	
271	    If wsEfc Is Nothing Or wsEpic Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
272	    If wsEfc.AutoFilterMode Then wsEfc.AutoFilterMode = False
273	    If wsEpic.AutoFilterMode Then wsEpic.AutoFilterMode = False
274	
275	    Dim epicCSNCol As Long, epicPhoneCol As Long
276	    epicCSNCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic CSN Header", "CSN"))
277	    epicPhoneCol = FindColByHeader(wsEpic, GetSetting("Epic Phone Header", "Phone"))
278	    If epicCSNCol = 0 Or epicPhoneCol = 0 Then
279	        MsgBox "Error: Epic file is missing required columns for the Phone join.", vbExclamation, "Missing Column"
280	        Exit Sub
281	    End If
282	
283	    Dim encCol As Long, mcafCol As Long
284	    encCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, GetSetting("eFC Encounter No Header", "Encounter No"))
285	    mcafCol = FindColByHeader(wsEfc, "MCAF Reminder")
286	    If encCol = 0 Or mcafCol = 0 Then Exit Sub   ' IdentifySmsRequired hasn't run yet
287	
288	    Dim lastRowEfc As Long
289	    lastRowEfc = wsEfc.Cells(wsEfc.Rows.Count, encCol).End(xlUp).Row
290	    If lastRowEfc < 2 Then Exit Sub
291	
292	    Dim lastRowEpic As Long
293	    lastRowEpic = wsEpic.Cells(wsEpic.Rows.Count, 1).End(xlUp).Row
294	    If lastRowEpic < 2 Then Exit Sub
295	
296	    Application.ScreenUpdating = False
297	
298	    ' --- Bulk-load Epic into CSN-keyed dictionaries, one per candidate slot ---
299	    Dim epicLastCol As Long
300	    epicLastCol = Application.WorksheetFunction.Max(epicCSNCol, epicPhoneCol)
301	    Dim epicData As Variant
302	    epicData = wsEpic.Range(wsEpic.Cells(1, 1), wsEpic.Cells(lastRowEpic, epicLastCol)).Value
303	
304	    Dim dictPhone1 As Object, dictPhone2 As Object, dictPhone3 As Object
305	    Set dictPhone1 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
306	    Set dictPhone2 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
307	    Set dictPhone3 = CreateObject("Scripting.Dictionary")
308	
309	    Dim i As Long, csn As String, p1 As String, p2 As String, p3 As String
310	    For i = 2 To lastRowEpic
311	        csn = SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicCSNCol))
312	        ExtractMobileNumbers SafeCStr(epicData(i, epicPhoneCol)), p1, p2, p3
313	        dictPhone1(csn) = p1
314	        dictPhone2(csn) = p2
315	        dictPhone3(csn) = p3
316	    Next i
317	
318	    ' --- Append "1st/2nd/3rd Phone Number" right after "MCAF Reminder" ---
319	    Dim phone1OutCol As Long, phone2OutCol As Long, phone3OutCol As Long
320	    phone1OutCol = mcafCol + 1
321	    phone2OutCol = mcafCol + 2
322	    phone3OutCol = mcafCol + 3
323	    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone1OutCol).Value = "1st Phone Number"
324	    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone2OutCol).Value = "2nd Phone Number"
325	    wsEfc.Cells(1, phone3OutCol).Value = "3rd Phone Number"
326	
327	    Dim efcData As Variant
328	    efcData = wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, 1), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, mcafCol)).Value
329	
330	    Dim phone1Out() As Variant, phone2Out() As Variant, phone3Out() As Variant
331	    ReDim phone1Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
332	    ReDim phone2Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
333	    ReDim phone3Out(1 To lastRowEfc - 1, 1 To 1)
334	
335	    Dim encNo As String, flag As String
336	    For i = 1 To UBound(efcData, 1)
337	        flag = SafeCStr(efcData(i, mcafCol))
338	        If flag = "SMS REQUIRED" Then
339	            encNo = SafeCStr(efcData(i, encCol))
340	            If dictPhone1.Exists(encNo) Then
341	                phone1Out(i, 1) = dictPhone1(encNo)
342	                phone2Out(i, 1) = dictPhone2(encNo)
343	                phone3Out(i, 1) = dictPhone3(encNo)
344	            Else
345	                phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
346	                phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
347	                phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
348	            End If
349	        Else
350	            phone1Out(i, 1) = ""
351	            phone2Out(i, 1) = ""
352	            phone3Out(i, 1) = ""
353	        End If
354	    Next i
355	
356	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone1OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone1OutCol)).Value = phone1Out
357	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone2OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone2OutCol)).Value = phone2Out
358	    wsEfc.Range(wsEfc.Cells(2, phone3OutCol), wsEfc.Cells(lastRowEfc, phone3OutCol)).Value = phone3Out
359	
360	Cleanup:
361	    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
362	        MsgBox "Error in JoinPhoneFromEpic: " & Err.Description, vbExclamation, "Unexpected Error"
363	    End If
364	    Application.ScreenUpdating = True
365	End Sub
366	
367	' Ports the SMS TEMPLATE workbook's "1st/2nd/3rd phone number" formulas
368	' (columns H/I/J): Epic's raw phone field looks like
369	'   "*9327 2613 (Mobile)" & vbCrLf & "6677 1216 (Home Phone)" & vbCrLf & "9664 9678 (Work Phone)"
370	' -- one or more labelled numbers, asterisks marking a preferred number, and
371	' line breaks between entries. Strips spaces and asterisks (matching the
372	' template's inline SUBSTITUTE(SUBSTITUTE(G2," ",""),"*","") step), then scans
373	' left to right for up to three non-overlapping 8-digit runs starting with
374	' "8" or "9" (the SG mobile prefixes), writing them into num1/num2/num3 in
375	' the order found. Deliberately does NOT reject Epic's "88888888"/"99999999"
376	' placeholder values here -- those are still valid *candidates* to show a
377	' human reviewer (see ReviewForm), same as the template's own H/I/J don't
378	' filter them either. Use FirstUsableNumber to pick one for the broadcast file.
379	Public Sub ExtractMobileNumbers(rawPhone As String, ByRef num1 As String, ByRef num2 As String, ByRef num3 As String)
380	    num1 = ""
381	    num2 = ""
382	    num3 = ""
383	
384	    Dim cleaned As String
385	    cleaned = Replace(rawPhone, " ", "")
386	    cleaned = Replace(cleaned, "*", "")
387	
388	    Dim n As Long
389	    n = Len(cleaned)
390	
391	    Dim found As Long
392	    found = 0
393	
394	    Dim i As Long, ch As String, candidate As String
395	    i = 1
396	    Do While i <= n - 7 And found < 3
397	        ch = Mid(cleaned, i, 1)
398	        If ch = "8" Or ch = "9" Then
399	            candidate = Mid(cleaned, i, 8)
400	            If IsEightDigits(candidate) Then
401	                found = found + 1
402	                Select Case found
403	                    Case 1: num1 = candidate
404	                    Case 2: num2 = candidate
405	                    Case 3: num3 = candidate
406	                End Select
407	                i = i + 8   ' non-overlapping: skip past this candidate
408	            Else
409	                i = i + 1
410	            End If
411	        Else
412	            i = i + 1
413	        End If
414	    Loop
415	End Sub
416	
417	' Loads the "Epic Placeholder Numbers" Config list once (falls back to
418	' 88888888/99999999) -- callers pass the result into FirstUsableNumber so a
419	' bulk-processing loop doesn't re-read Config per row.
420	Public Sub LoadPlaceholderList(ByRef outList() As String, ByRef outCount As Long)
421	    LoadPhraseList "Epic Placeholder Numbers", Array("88888888", "99999999"), outList, outCount
422	End Sub
423	
424	' Picks the single number that goes into the final broadcast file (SOP step
425	' 5/9 requires exactly one "Mobile Number" per row) -- the first of the
426	' three candidates that isn't blank or a configured placeholder value.
427	' ReviewForm still shows all three raw candidates so PSA can see and
428	' override what got picked, rather than this decision being made invisibly.
429	Public Function FirstUsableNumber(num1 As String, num2 As String, num3 As String, _
430	                                   placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As String
431	    If IsUsableNumber(num1, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
432	        FirstUsableNumber = num1
433	    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num2, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
434	        FirstUsableNumber = num2
435	    ElseIf IsUsableNumber(num3, placeholders, placeholderCount) Then
436	        FirstUsableNumber = num3
437	    Else
438	        FirstUsableNumber = ""
439	    End If
440	End Function
441	
442	Private Function IsUsableNumber(num As String, placeholders() As String, placeholderCount As Long) As Boolean
443	    If num = "" Then
444	        IsUsableNumber = False
445	        Exit Function
446	    End If
447	
448	    Dim i As Long
449	    For i = 1 To placeholderCount
450	        If num = placeholders(i) Then
451	            IsUsableNumber = False
452	            Exit Function
453	        End If
454	    Next i
455	
456	    IsUsableNumber = True
457	End Function
458	
459	' True if s is exactly 8 characters, all digits 0-9.
460	Private Function IsEightDigits(s As String) As Boolean
461	    If Len(s) <> 8 Then
462	        IsEightDigits = False
463	        Exit Function
464	    End If
465	
466	    Dim k As Long, c As String
467	    For k = 1 To 8
468	        c = Mid(s, k, 1)
469	        If c < "0" Or c > "9" Then
470	            IsEightDigits = False
471	            Exit Function
472	        End If
473	    Next k
474	
475	    IsEightDigits = True
476	End Function
